title: 5 source-grounded AF rotor research topics
description: Produce exactly 5 distinct, non-overlapping research paper topics on the role of rotors in atrial fibrillation. Each topic includes a one-sentence mechanistic rationale. Topics must span at least 3 mechanistic domains (e.g., ion-channel/electrophysiology, fibrosis/structural substrate, mapping methodology, autonomic modulation), clearly distinguish hypothesis-generating ideas from established evidence, use precise scientific language, and be grounded in / cross-checked against the cardiology-canon-v2 bookshelf.
